title: Reorganize VAT calculator UI: move Service/Product Category to Invoice step, compact controls, and improve VAT Category selector

requirements.text: Move the “Service/Product Category” field out of the Results flow and into the Invoice step: remove the Service/Product Category selector from the VAT calculator Transaction/Results UI and add it under the Invoice tab/step, positioned before the item description field/column.

quotes: remove the Service Product category from the Results tab and add it under the Invoice tab before the description column.

acceptanceCriteria: In the VAT calculation flow, the user can no longer select or view “Service/Product Category” in the Results UI.
In the Invoice step (Invoice details), “Service/Product Category” is available as an input and appears before the item description input/column.
Existing invoice generation/preview still works and includes the selected category in the invoice line-item layout (as a column before Description, when a columnar line-item table is used).

requirements.text: Reduce the visual size (compact the layout) of the “Enable Reverse Charge” and “VAT Treatment” UI controls so they take less space, especially on desktop/tablet widths.

quotes: Reduce the Box size of Enable Reverse charge  and VAT Treatment columns.

acceptanceCriteria: The “Enable Reverse Charge” control is rendered with reduced padding/height compared to the current card layout while remaining readable and clickable.
The “VAT Treatment” control group is rendered more compactly (reduced padding/spacing), without truncating labels or rate badges.
No overlap/clipping occurs in common viewports (mobile + md/lg breakpoints).

requirements.text: Reposition the “VAT Category” control to the right side of the “Transaction Details” section layout (i.e., right column on md+ breakpoints), while keeping a sensible stacked layout on mobile.

quotes: Move the VAT Category to the right side of transaction details.

acceptanceCriteria: On md+ breakpoints, the “VAT Category” selector appears in the right column of the Transaction Details inputs area.
On mobile, the Transaction Details inputs remain in a single-column stacked layout with a logical field order.
No validation or calculation behavior changes as a result of the layout move.

requirements.text: Update the VAT Category dropdown so that only 5 VAT Category options are visible at once, with vertical scrolling enabled to reach the remaining categories.

quotes: Ensure only 5 items are visible at any given time along with the option to scroll down and select the correct VAT Category.

acceptanceCriteria: When opening the VAT Category dropdown, the options list shows a maximum of ~5 items without scrolling.
If more than 5 categories exist, the dropdown list is scrollable and all categories remain selectable.
Keyboard navigation still works within the scrollable dropdown (up/down + enter).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not modify immutable hook entrypoints (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts / useActor.ts).
Keep all changes within the existing React + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn component patterns already used in the app.
nonGoals: No changes to VAT calculation logic or VAT scenario determination.
No backend (Motoko) changes or data migrations.
No changes to Stripe, plans, or invoice storage behavior beyond displaying the moved field.
